itens.trecho: I suppose when you tell us all in advance that this is only going to be part three of a franchise, we can’t be surprised when the story doesn’t really go anywhere. Well here there isn’t really much of a story at all, just an extension of the last outing with a denouement that almost exactly duplicates “The Way of Water” from 2022.

itens.autor: The Fixate & Binge Podcast, w/ Joe Curdy
itens.trecho: Even Shakespeare's Polonius complained to Prince Hamlet that the traveling actors' Greek Tragedy speeches were too long -- and over four centuries later there is still something to be said about testing audience patience.

The three stars out of 5 that I (barely) gave this movie is entirely due to the scenery, special effects and the action. The rest is meh, at best. First of all, a lot of the movie is really a rehash of the second movie. Sure, they throw in the Ash People but the rest is to a large extent very similar.
